events.text: The Senate of the Kingdom of Italy was created.
events.subject: self
events.object: Senate of the Kingdom of Italy
events.quote: The Senate of the Kingdom of Italy was created in 1861

events.text: The Senate was moved to the Palazzo Madama in Rome.
events.subject: self
events.quote: in 1871 , it was moved to the Palazzo Madama in Rome

events.text: 211 new members were added to the Senate.
events.subject: self
events.quote: in 1939 , when the lower house was transformed into the Chamber of Fasces and Corporations , 211 new members were added to the Senate

events.text: King Victor Emmanuel III appointed Paolo Thaon di Revel as the President of the Senate.
events.subject: self
events.quote: When Fascism fell on 25 July 1943 , King Victor Emmanuel III appointed Paolo Thaon di Revel as the President of the Senate

events.text: Paolo Thaon di Revel entered office as President of the Senate.
events.subject: part_of_self

events.text: Pietro Tomasi Della Torretta was appointed as the final President of the Senate.
events.subject: part_of_self
events.quote: On 20 July 1944 , Pietro Tomasi Della Torretta was appointed as the final President of the Senate

events.text: Pietro Tomasi Della Torretta retained the office of President of the Senate until 25 June 1946.
events.subject: part_of_self
events.quote: an office which he retained until 25 June 1946

events.text: All Senators responsible for maintaining Fascism and enabling the war were dismissed from office.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In August 1944 , all Senators responsible for maintaining Fascism and enabling the war

events.text: The Senate of the Kingdom ceased to function.
events.subject: self
events.quote: the Senate of the Kingdom ceased to function on 25 June 1946

events.subject: self
events.quote: It was formally suppressed on 7 November 1947

events.text: The Senate of the Republic came into existence.
events.subject: other
events.quote: the current Senate of the Republic , which came into existence on 8 May 1948
